crossRefs.note: God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.
Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.
Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.
He will again have compassion on us. He will tread our iniquities under foot; and you will cast all their sins into the…
Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep…
I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.
Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.
“Now therefore, our God, listen to the prayer of your servant, and to his petitions, and cause your face to shine on…
When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

translations.web: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.
translations.bsb: Turn to me and be gracious, for I am lonely and afflicted.
translations.kjv: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.
translations.asv: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; For I am desolate and afflicted.
